questions.q: Everyone likes our _____ teacher. She teaches biology quite patiently and always shows us lots of examples.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) science。後句明確說她教 biology（生物），因此是 science teacher（自然科／科學老師）。scarf 是圍巾，geography 是地理，scene 是場景。

questions.q: We weren’t early enough to _____ the train. We could only see it leaving!
questions.e: 答案是 (A) get on。get on the train 表示『上火車』。因為到得不夠早，只能看著車離開，所以是沒趕上車。turn on 是打開電器，depend on 是依靠，keep on 是持續。

questions.q: _____ up earlier, and we can catch the first bus.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) Get。這是『祈使句 + and + 結果句』：Get up earlier, and we can catch the first bus. 意思是『早一點起床，我們就能趕上第一班公車。』祈使句動詞要用原形。

questions.q: Little George is so short _____ he can’t reach the cookie jar by himself.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) that。固定句型 so + 形容詞 + that + 子句，表示『如此……以致於……』。句意為 George 太矮了，以致於他自己拿不到餅乾罐。

questions.q: Tom forgot to do the dishes, so Mrs. Lin made him _____ the floor instead.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) mop。使役動詞 make 的句型是 make + 人 + 原形動詞，所以 made him mop the floor。不能用 to mop。

questions.q: We’ve already had too much information every day, _____?
questions.e: 答案是 (D) haven’t we。主句是 We’ve had...，We’ve = We have，使用現在完成式且為肯定句，因此附加問句用否定的 haven’t we?

questions.q: After a two-hour search, the missing boy _____ in a toy store nearby.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) was found。失蹤男孩是『被找到』，因此要用被動語態 be + p.p.；事件發生在過去，所以用 was found。

questions.q: Ms. Simmons asked us _____ in class.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) not to talk。ask + 人 + to V 表示『要求某人做某事』；否定式把 not 放在 to 前面：ask + 人 + not to V。

questions.q: Did you see the girl _____ lost her puppy?
questions.e: 答案是 (D) who。先行詞 the girl 是人，而且關係代名詞在子句 who lost her puppy 中擔任主詞，所以必須用 who，不能省略；which 用於事物。
